# Trade accounting is separate from provider payroll snapshots.
# Do not assume a reported salary is a CBT charge or that unknown values are zero.
trade_cash_transfer <- function(salary, retained) {
  stopifnot(length(salary) == length(retained),
    all(is.na(salary) | (is.finite(salary) & salary >= 0)),
    all(is.na(retained) | (is.finite(retained) & retained >= 0)),
    all(is.na(salary) | is.na(retained) | retained <= salary))
  salary - retained
}

read_trade_ledger <- function(path = "data/trade_history.csv",
                              teams_path = "data/mlb_2027_payroll_base.csv") {
  d <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character",
                na.strings = "", check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  required <- c("Trade_ID", "Movement_ID", "Payroll_Season", "Transaction_Date",
    "Player", "From_Team_ID", "To_Team_ID", "Status", "Salary_Before_Trade_Millions",
    "Salary_Retained_By_From_Club_Millions", "From_Club_CBT_Change_Millions",
    "To_Club_CBT_Change_Millions", "Snapshot_Reconciliation", "Deal_Notes", "Source", "Source_URL")
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(d)), !anyDuplicated(names(d)))
  d <- d[, required]
  essential <- c(required[1:8], "Snapshot_Reconciliation", "Source", "Source_URL")
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d[, essential]), all(nzchar(trimws(as.matrix(d[, essential])))),
    !anyDuplicated(d$Movement_ID), !anyDuplicated(paste(d$Trade_ID, d$Player)),
    all(grepl("^https://", d$Source_URL)),
    all(d$Status %in% c("Official trade", "Reported trade", "Withdrawn")),
    all(d$Snapshot_Reconciliation %in% c("Unreconciled", "Included", "Not included")))
  teams <- read.csv(teams_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)$Team_ID
  stopifnot(all(d$From_Team_ID %in% teams), all(d$To_Team_ID %in% teams),
    all(d$From_Team_ID != d$To_Team_ID))
  dates <- as.Date(d$Transaction_Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  stopifnot(!anyNA(dates), all(format(dates, "%Y-%m-%d") == d$Transaction_Date),
    all(dates <= Sys.Date()))
  stopifnot(all(grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", d$Payroll_Season)),
    all(as.integer(d$Payroll_Season) %in% 1900:2100))
  for (col in required[9:12]) {
    raw <- d[[col]]
    d[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw))
    stopifnot(all(is.na(raw) | is.finite(d[[col]])))
  }
  amount <- trade_cash_transfer(d$Salary_Before_Trade_Millions,
                                 d$Salary_Retained_By_From_Club_Millions)
  d$From_Club_Salary_Change_Millions <- -amount
  d$To_Club_Salary_Change_Millions <- amount
  d$From_Club_Salary_Change_Millions[d$Status != "Official trade"] <- NA_real_
  d$To_Club_Salary_Change_Millions[d$Status != "Official trade"] <- NA_real_
  stopifnot(all(is.na(d$From_Club_Salary_Change_Millions) |
    abs(d$From_Club_Salary_Change_Millions + d$To_Club_Salary_Change_Millions) < 1e-8))
  d[order(d$Transaction_Date, d$Trade_ID, d$Movement_ID, decreasing = TRUE), ]
}

name: scenario_accounting.R
content:
# Scenario accounting in millions of dollars. Missing player-level data are explicit assumptions.
policy_assumptions <- function() {
  list(media_share_pct=100, media_revenue_pct=20, media_start=2027,
       cap_start=2027, scenario_year=2027, min_players_under2=12,
       min_players_2plus=5, arbitration_payroll=22,
       arbitration_bonus_pct=0, arbitration_bonus_start=2028,
       veteran_bonus=0, super_two_pct=22, arb_candidates=4, arb_raise=2,
       prearb_min_bonus=0, prearb_eligible=12,
       min_arb_salary=0, arb_floor_players=3, arb_floor_baseline=2,
       attendance_coef=0.7638659, revenue_growth=0.047417, payroll_coef=0.0273665)
}
complete_policy <- function(p) modifyList(policy_assumptions(), p)
projection_baseline <- function(historical, forecasts, payroll) {
  stopifnot(nrow(forecasts)==30,nrow(payroll)==30,
    !anyDuplicated(forecasts$Team_ID),!anyDuplicated(payroll$Team_ID),
    setequal(historical$Team_ID,forecasts$Team_ID),setequal(historical$Team_ID,payroll$Team_ID),
    length(unique(forecasts$Snapshot_Date))==1,
    identical(as.character(unique(forecasts$Snapshot_Date)),as.character(unique(payroll$Snapshot_Date))))
  i <- match(historical$Team_ID,forecasts$Team_ID)
  j <- match(historical$Team_ID,payroll$Team_ID)
  stopifnot(all(abs(forecasts$Projected_2027_Payroll_Millions[i]-payroll$Latest_Payroll_Millions[j])<1e-6))
  out <- historical
  out$Payroll_M <- forecasts$Projected_2027_Payroll_Millions[i]
  out$CBT_Payroll_M <- payroll$Latest_CBT_Millions[j]
  out$Win_Pct <- forecasts$Expected_Wins_2027[i]/162
  out$Revenue_Millions <- forecasts$Revenue_2027[i]
  out$Attendance <- forecasts$Attendance_2027[i]
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(out$Payroll_M)),all(out$Payroll_M>0),
    all(is.finite(out$CBT_Payroll_M)),all(out$CBT_Payroll_M>0),
    all(is.finite(out$Revenue_Millions)),all(out$Revenue_Millions>0),
    all(is.finite(out$Attendance)),all(out$Attendance>0),
    abs(sum(out$Win_Pct)-15)<1e-6)
  out$Model3_Wins_From_25M <- 162*payroll_effect*log1p(25/out$Payroll_M)
  out
}
policy_transfers <- function(p,baseline) {
  p <- complete_policy(p)
  active <- p$central_media && p$scenario_year>=p$media_start
  media <- baseline$Revenue_Millions*p$media_revenue_pct/100
  pooled <- if(active) media*p$media_share_pct/100 else rep(0,nrow(baseline))
  media_transfer <- mean(pooled)-pooled
  ordinary_contribution <- (baseline$Revenue_Millions-pooled)*p$revenue_sharing/100
  ordinary_transfer <- mean(ordinary_contribution)-ordinary_contribution
  list(media=media_transfer,ordinary=ordinary_transfer,net=media_transfer+ordinary_transfer)
}
player_pay_costs <- function(p,n=30) {
  p <- complete_policy(p)
  minimum <- p$min_players_under2*max(0,p$minimum_salary_under2-.78)+
    p$min_players_2plus*max(0,p$minimum_salary_2plus-.78)
  eligibility <- if(p$arbitration=="2") 100 else p$super_two_pct
  # Newly eligible players are separate from already arbitration-eligible floor recipients.
  earlier_arb <- p$arb_candidates*max(0,eligibility-22)/100*max(p$arb_raise,p$min_arb_salary-.78)
  arb_floor <- p$arb_floor_players*max(0,p$min_arb_salary-p$arb_floor_baseline)
  arb <- if(p$scenario_year>=p$arbitration_bonus_start) p$arbitration_payroll*p$arbitration_bonus_pct/100 else 0
  list(minimum=rep(minimum,n),earlier_arb=rep(earlier_arb,n),arb_floor=rep(arb_floor,n),arbitration_bonus=rep(arb,n),
    veteran_bonus=rep(p$veteran_bonus,n),prearb_delta=rep((p$prearb_pool-50)/n,n))
}
contract_delta <- function(new,already_in_snapshot) {
  if(is.na(new)||is.na(already_in_snapshot)) return(NA_real_)
  new-already_in_snapshot
}
contract_ledger <- function(path="data/annual_contracts.csv") {
  d <- read.csv(path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings=c("","NA"))
  required <- c("Contract_ID","Player","Club","Transaction_Type","Signed_Date","Effective_Season",
    "Obligation_Season","Salary_M","Cash_Payment_M","CBT_Charge_M","Baseline_Salary_M",
    "Baseline_CBT_M","Snapshot_Reconciliation","Status","Source_URL","Notes",
    "Prior_Salary_M","Published_Projection_M","Signing_Bonus_M","Deferred_Earnings_M","Deferred_Payment_M","Option_M","Buyout_M","Retained_Salary_M")
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(d)),!anyDuplicated(d[c("Contract_ID","Club","Obligation_Season")]))
  for(field in c("Salary_M","Cash_Payment_M","CBT_Charge_M","Baseline_Salary_M","Baseline_CBT_M","Prior_Salary_M","Published_Projection_M","Signing_Bonus_M","Deferred_Earnings_M","Deferred_Payment_M","Option_M","Buyout_M","Retained_Salary_M"))
    stopifnot(all(is.na(d[[field]])|(is.finite(d[[field]])&d[[field]]>=0)))
  stopifnot(all(d$Obligation_Season>=d$Effective_Season),
    all(d$Snapshot_Reconciliation %in% c("Included","Not included","Unreconciled")))
  d$Salary_Change_From_Prior_M <- mapply(contract_delta,d$Salary_M,d$Prior_Salary_M)
  d$Difference_From_Projection_M <- mapply(contract_delta,d$Salary_M,d$Published_Projection_M)
  d$Incremental_Payroll_M <- mapply(contract_delta,d$Salary_M,d$Baseline_Salary_M)
  d$Incremental_CBT_M <- mapply(contract_delta,d$CBT_Charge_M,d$Baseline_CBT_M)
  d$Incremental_Payroll_M[d$Snapshot_Reconciliation=="Unreconciled"] <- NA_real_
  d$Incremental_CBT_M[d$Snapshot_Reconciliation=="Unreconciled"] <- NA_real_
  d
}

# Applied scenario adjustments are a separate view, not contract reconciliation proof.
# Match on stable contract/event ID, club and season, never player name.
contract_applied_view <- function(ledger, events) {
  key <- function(id,club,year) paste(id,club,year,sep="|")
  k <- key(events$Event_ID,events$Club,events$Effective_Season)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(k))
  i <- match(key(ledger$Contract_ID,ledger$Club,ledger$Obligation_Season),k)
  cash <- events$Payroll_Status[i]; cbt <- events$CBT_Status[i]
  ledger$Applied_Payroll_M <- ifelse(!is.na(cash)&cash!="Pending",events$New_Payroll_M[i]-events$Prior_Payroll_M[i],NA_real_)
  ledger$Applied_CBT_M <- ifelse(!is.na(cbt)&cbt=="Confirmed",events$New_CBT_M[i]-events$Prior_CBT_M[i],NA_real_)
  ledger$Applied_Status <- ifelse(is.na(cash),"Not reviewed",ifelse(cash=="Pending","Pending reconciliation",paste(cash,"scenario adjustment")))
  ledger$Applied_CBT_Status <- ifelse(is.na(cbt),"Not reviewed",cbt)
  ledger$Adjustment_Notes <- events$Notes[i]
  ledger
}

# Rebuild the reactionary scenario from reviewed facts, not a roster census.
# Zero is a MODEL assumption only for new-club arrivals or known departures;
# unknown annual salary, retained obligations and CBT are never filled with zero.
incremental_event_view <- function(events, signings, ledger) {
  original <- events
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(events[c("Event_ID","Club","Effective_Season")]),
            !anyDuplicated(signings$Signing_ID))
  can_apply <- function(i) {
    events$Payroll_Status[i]=="Pending" &&
      !any(seq_len(nrow(events))!=i & events$Player==events$Player[i] &
        events$Club==events$Club[i] & events$Effective_Season==events$Effective_Season[i] &
        events$Payroll_Status!="Pending")
  }
  apply_delta <- function(i, prior, new, note) {
    stopifnot(is.finite(prior),is.finite(new),prior>=0,new>=0)
    events$Prior_Payroll_M[i] <<- prior
    events$New_Payroll_M[i] <<- new
    events$Payroll_Status[i] <<- "Provisional"
    events$Notes[i] <<- paste(original$Notes[i],"Incremental scenario:",note)
  }
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(signings))) {
    s <- signings[k,]
    if(s$Status=="Withdrawn") next
    i <- which(events$Event_ID==s$Signing_ID & events$Club==s$New_Team_ID & events$Effective_Season==2027)
    if(length(i)!=1L || !can_apply(i)) next
    row <- ledger[ledger$Contract_ID==s$Signing_ID & ledger$Club==s$New_Team_ID &
      ledger$Obligation_Season==2027 & ledger$Transaction_Type=="Free agency",,drop=FALSE]
    if(nrow(row)!=1L || row$Status %in% c("Contingent","Conflicting salary reports")) next
    different_club <- !is.na(s$Previous_Team_ID) && nzchar(s$Previous_Team_ID) && s$Previous_Team_ID!=s$New_Team_ID
    overseas <- (is.na(s$Previous_Team_ID)||!nzchar(s$Previous_Team_ID)) &&
      grepl("NPB|Japan",row$Notes,ignore.case=TRUE)
    if((different_club||overseas) && is.na(row$Salary_M)) {
      if(grepl("Reviewed nominal-AAV model proxy",original$Notes[i],fixed=TRUE) &&
        is.finite(s$Total_Value_Millions) && is.finite(s$Years) && s$Years>0) {
        apply_delta(i,0,s$Total_Value_Millions/s$Years,"nominal AAV spending proxy ONLY; not reported annual cash, salary or CBT. Replaced when annual salary becomes known.")
      }
      next
    }
    if(is.na(row$Salary_M)) next
    if(different_club||overseas) {
      apply_delta(i,0,row$Salary_M,"reported annual salary; assumes player was absent from acquiring club's historical anchor. Cash timing and CBT remain unverified.")
    } else if(!is.na(row$Prior_Salary_M)) {
      apply_delta(i,row$Prior_Salary_M,row$Salary_M,"reported old and new annual salary; assumes old amount included in anchor.")
    }
  }
  # A known old salary is usable for a provisional departure, not a claim that
  # all residual obligations are known. A prior non-tender supersedes a second exit.
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(signings))) {
    s <- signings[k,]
    if(s$Status=="Withdrawn" || is.na(s$Previous_Team_ID) ||
      !nzchar(s$Previous_Team_ID) || s$Previous_Team_ID==s$New_Team_ID) next
    i <- which(events$Event_ID==s$Signing_ID & events$Club==s$Previous_Team_ID & events$Effective_Season==2027)
    if(length(i)!=1L || !can_apply(i) || is.na(events$Prior_Payroll_M[i])) next
    nt <- ledger$Player==s$Player & ledger$Club==s$Previous_Team_ID &
      ledger$Transaction_Type=="Non-tender" & ledger$Obligation_Season==2027
    if(any(nt)) next
    apply_delta(i,events$Prior_Payroll_M[i],0,"reported former-club annual salary; assumes inclusion in anchor and no remaining modeled salary for the departing player. Residual payments and CBT unknown.")
  }
  for(k in seq_len(nrow(ledger))) {
    r <- ledger[k,]
    if(r$Obligation_Season!=2027 || !r$Transaction_Type %in% c("Arbitration settlement","Extension","Non-tender")) next
    i <- which(events$Event_ID==r$Contract_ID & events$Club==r$Club & events$Effective_Season==2027)
    if(length(i)!=1L || !can_apply(i) || is.na(r$Prior_Salary_M)) next
    if(r$Transaction_Type=="Non-tender" && r$Status=="Non-tendered") {
      apply_delta(i,r$Prior_Salary_M,0,"reported prior salary; assumes inclusion in anchor and no residual modeled salary after non-tender. CBT unknown.")
    } else if(!is.na(r$Salary_M) && !r$Status %in% c("Contingent","Conflicting salary reports") &&
      !grepl("not (on|a comparable).*opening.day|September waiver|September claim",r$Notes,ignore.case=TRUE)) {
      apply_delta(i,r$Prior_Salary_M,r$Salary_M,"reported annual salary change; assumes prior salary included in historical anchor. Cash timing and CBT unknown.")
    }
  }
  stopifnot(identical(events$Prior_CBT_M,original$Prior_CBT_M),
            identical(events$New_CBT_M,original$New_CBT_M),
            identical(events$CBT_Status,original$CBT_Status))
  events
}
read_incremental_events <- function(path="data/live_payroll_adjustments.csv",
                                     signing_path="data/free_agency_input.csv",
                                     ledger_path="data/annual_contracts.csv") {
  raw <- read.csv(path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings=c("","NA"))
  signings <- read.csv(signing_path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE,na.strings=c("","NA"))
  incremental_event_view(raw,signings,contract_ledger(ledger_path))
}

name: bargaining_model.R
content:
# Benchmark-relative bargaining utility indices. Not estimated acceptance probabilities.
# Preset outcomes use the same baseline, scenario year and empirical assumptions as the candidate.
bargaining_cache <- new.env(parent=emptyenv())
bargaining_assumptions <- c("scenario_year","media_revenue_pct","min_players_under2",
  "min_players_2plus","prearb_eligible","arbitration_payroll","arb_candidates","arb_raise",
  "arb_floor_players","arb_floor_baseline","attendance_coef","revenue_growth","payroll_coef")

bargaining_features <- function(policy,m) {
  p <- complete_policy(policy)
  c(balance=m$competitive_balance_change, payroll_equality=m$baseline_gini-m$gini,
    club_net=m$club_effect, club_downside=m$worst_club_effect_share,
    revenue_equality=m$revenue_gini_reduction, player_pay=m$player_comp_change,
    early_pay=m$minimum_salary_cost+m$earlier_arb_cost+m$arbitration_floor_cost+
      m$prearb_delta+m$arbitration_bonus,
    lower_club_spending=m$low_revenue_payroll_change,
    market_tax=-m$cbt_tax,
    media=if(p$central_media) p$media_share_pct else 0,
    cap=as.numeric(p$upper_rule=="cap"), floor=as.numeric(p$lower_rule=="floor"),
    freedom=as.numeric(p$upper_rule!="cap"),
    arbitration=if(p$arbitration=="2") 100 else p$super_two_pct,
    free_agency=as.numeric(p$free_agency=="5_age30"), qo_removed=as.numeric(!p$qualifying_offer))
}

bargaining_reference <- function(ctx) {
  key <- digest::digest(ctx)
  if(exists(key,envir=bargaining_cache,inherits=FALSE)) return(get(key,envir=bargaining_cache))
  policies <- list(current=current_cba_policy(),MLB=mlb_proposal_policy(),MLBPA=mlbpa_proposal_policy())
  f <- t(vapply(policies,function(p) {
    p <- modifyList(complete_policy(p),ctx$assumptions)
    m <- simulate_policy(p,payroll_coef=ctx$coef,behavior_multiplier=ctx$response,
      baseline=ctx$baseline,full=FALSE)$metrics
    bargaining_features(p,m)
  },numeric(16)))
  ref <- list(low=apply(f,2,min),high=apply(f,2,max),features=f)
  if(length(ls(bargaining_cache))>100) rm(list=ls(bargaining_cache),envir=bargaining_cache)
  assign(key,ref,envir=bargaining_cache)
  ref
}

benchmark_score <- function(value,low,high) {
  span <- high-low
  # Identical reference outcomes do not establish a preference scale.
  out <- rep(50,length(value)); names(out) <- names(value)
  varied <- is.finite(span)&span>1e-9
  out[varied] <- 100*clamp((value[varied]-low[varied])/span[varied],0,1)
  out
}

negotiation_scores <- function(policy,metrics,details=TRUE) {
  stopifnot(!is.null(metrics$score_context))
  ref <- bargaining_reference(metrics$score_context)
  raw <- bargaining_features(policy,metrics)
  z <- benchmark_score(raw,ref$low,ref$high)
  # Retain the existing category weights. Within categories use equal weighting
  # where no evidence identifies relative preferences. Explicit proposal preferences
  # remain ordinal; no invented acceptance probabilities or absolute dollar-to-point rates.
  owner <- c(mean(z[c("balance","payroll_equality")]),
    mean(z[c("club_net","club_downside")]),
    mean(z[c("revenue_equality","media")]),
    mean(z[c("cap","floor")]))
  union <- c(z[["player_pay"]],mean(z[c("freedom","market_tax")]),z[["early_pay"]],
    mean(z[c("arbitration","free_agency","qo_removed")]),
    mean(z[c("lower_club_spending","media")]))
  ow <- c(30,25,20,25); uw <- c(30,25,15,20,10)
  mlb <- sum(ow*owner)/100; mlbpa <- sum(uw*union)/100
  compromise <- min(mlb,mlbpa); gap <- abs(mlb-mlbpa)
  viability <- clamp(.70*compromise+.30*mean(c(mlb,mlbpa))-.40*gap,0,100)
  result <- list(mlb=mlb,mlbpa=mlbpa,compromise=compromise,viability=viability,
    joint_support=sqrt(mlb*mlbpa),gap=gap)
  if(!details) return(result)
  result$mlb_components <- tibble(Component=c("Competitive balance and payroll equality",
    "Aggregate and worst-club financial effect","Revenue equality and media pooling",
    "Hard cap and floor proposal alignment"),Weight=ow,Score=owner)
  result$mlbpa_components <- tibble(Component=c("Modeled player compensation",
    "Labor-market freedom and CBT exposure","Modeled early-career compensation",
    "Arbitration, free agency and qualifying offer rights","Lower-revenue club spending and media pooling"),
    Weight=uw,Score=union)
  result$benchmark_components <- tibble(Indicator=names(raw),Current=as.numeric(ref$features["current",]),
    MLB=as.numeric(ref$features["MLB",]),MLBPA=as.numeric(ref$features["MLBPA",]),
    Selected=as.numeric(raw),Normalized=as.numeric(z))
  result
}

name: optimizer.R
content:
# Proposal-inspired screening ranges, not legal limits or calibrated acceptance estimates.
# Unrestricted manual scenarios remain available.
recommendation_checks <- function(p) {
  p <- complete_policy(p)
  inside <- function(x,lo,hi) length(x)==1 && is.finite(x) && x>=lo && x<=hi
  issues <- character()
  if(!p$upper_rule %in% c("cap","cbt")) issues <- c(issues,"No upper-payroll restriction")
  if(p$upper_rule=="cap") {
    if(!inside(p$upper_value,220,300)) issues <- c(issues,"Cap outside $220–300M")
    if(p$cap_start<2028) issues <- c(issues,"Cap transition before 2028")
    if(p$lower_rule!="floor") issues <- c(issues,"Cap without floor")
    if(p$lower_rule=="floor" && (!is.finite(p$lower_value)||p$upper_value-p$lower_value<50||p$lower_value>0.8*p$upper_value)) issues <- c(issues,"Cap and floor too close")
  }
  if(p$upper_rule=="cbt" && (!inside(p$upper_value,220,325)||!inside(p$upper_tax_rate,10,60))) issues <- c(issues,"CBT outside $220–325M or 10–60%")
  if(p$lower_rule!="none" && !inside(p$lower_value,120,190)) issues <- c(issues,"Lower threshold outside $120–190M")
  if(p$lower_rule=="tax" && !inside(p$lower_tax_rate,10,60)) issues <- c(issues,"Low-spending tax outside 10–60%")
  if(p$upper_rule=="cbt" && p$lower_rule!="none" && p$upper_value-p$lower_value<50) issues <- c(issues,"Upper and lower thresholds too close")
  if(!inside(p$revenue_sharing,10,35)||!inside(p$required_spending,0,75)) issues <- c(issues,"Sharing outside 10–35% / 0–75%")
  if(!p$central_media || p$media_share_pct!=100 || !p$media_start %in% c(2027,2028)) issues <- c(issues,"Preserve equal media pooling in principle")
  if(!inside(p$player_revenue_share,45,55)) issues <- c(issues,"Player revenue share outside 45–55%")
  if(!inside(p$minimum_salary_under2,.78,1.5)||!inside(p$minimum_salary_2plus,.78,1.5)||p$minimum_salary_under2>p$minimum_salary_2plus) issues <- c(issues,"Minimum salary outside proposal-inspired ranges or reversed service tiers")
  if(!inside(p$prearb_pool,50,180)||p$prearb_pool<30*p$prearb_min_bonus*p$prearb_eligible) issues <- c(issues,"Bonus pool outside $50–180M or insufficient to fund minimum")
  if(p$arbitration!="3"||!inside(p$super_two_pct,22,44)||!inside(p$min_arb_salary,0,3)) issues <- c(issues,"Arbitration provisions beyond reported proposals")
  if(!inside(p$arbitration_bonus_pct,0,5)||!inside(p$veteran_bonus,0,.5)||!inside(p$prearb_min_bonus,0,.1)) issues <- c(issues,"Bonuses beyond proposal ranges")
  if(p$arbitration_bonus_pct>0&&p$arbitration_bonus_start<2028) issues <- c(issues,"Settlement bonus before proposed 2028 class")
  issues
}

# Central screening and robust sensitivity testing. Heuristic support, not ratification probabilities.
optimizer_grid <- function() {
  upper <- bind_rows(tibble(upper_rule="cap",upper_value=c(220,250,258.2,280),upper_tax_rate=0),
    crossing(upper_rule="cbt",upper_value=c(220,250,280,300),upper_tax_rate=c(20,40,60)),
    tibble(upper_rule="none",upper_value=NA_real_,upper_tax_rate=0))
  lower <- bind_rows(tibble(lower_rule="floor",lower_value=c(120,150,180,180.2),lower_tax_rate=0),
    crossing(lower_rule="tax",lower_value=c(120,150,180),lower_tax_rate=c(20,40,60)),
    tibble(lower_rule="none",lower_value=NA_real_,lower_tax_rate=0))
  crossing(upper,lower,revenue_sharing=c(10,20,30),required_spending=c(25,50,75)) %>%
    filter(!(upper_rule=="cap"&lower_rule=="floor"&upper_value<=lower_value))
}
optimize_cba <- function(terms,baseline,behavior=1,lock_player_terms=FALSE,
                        grid=optimizer_grid(),shortlist_size=40,progress=function(i,n,stage){}) {
  terms <- complete_policy(terms)
  # Maximize weaker-side support subject to economic and contractual feasibility.
  variants <- list(terms)
  if(!lock_player_terms) variants <- c(variants,list(
    modifyList(terms,list(minimum_salary_under2=1,minimum_salary_2plus=1,prearb_pool=65,central_media=TRUE,free_agency="5_age30",qualifying_offer=FALSE)),
    modifyList(terms,list(minimum_salary_under2=1.25,minimum_salary_2plus=1.25,prearb_pool=120,central_media=TRUE,free_agency="5_age30",qualifying_offer=FALSE,super_two_pct=35)),
    modifyList(terms,list(minimum_salary_under2=1.5,minimum_salary_2plus=1.5,prearb_pool=180,central_media=TRUE,free_agency="5_age30",qualifying_offer=FALSE,super_two_pct=44))))
  if(!lock_player_terms) variants <- c(variants,list(
    modifyList(terms,list(minimum_salary_under2=1.5,minimum_salary_2plus=1.5,prearb_pool=180,central_media=TRUE,free_agency="5_age30",qualifying_offer=FALSE,arbitration="3",super_two_pct=44)),
    modifyList(terms,list(minimum_salary_under2=1.5,minimum_salary_2plus=1.5,prearb_pool=150,central_media=TRUE,free_agency="5_age30",qualifying_offer=FALSE,super_two_pct=44,min_arb_salary=3))))
  # Media pooling is a shared bargaining principle, not a concession to optimize away.
  if(!lock_player_terms) variants <- lapply(variants,function(p) modifyList(p,list(central_media=TRUE,media_share_pct=100,media_start=2027,arbitration="3",super_two_pct=min(44,p$super_two_pct))))
  variants <- unique(variants)
  ids <- expand.grid(structure=seq_len(nrow(grid)),variant=seq_along(variants))
  grid_policy <- function(i) {
    row <- grid[ids$structure[i],]
    p <- variants[[ids$variant[i]]]
    for(nm in c("upper_rule","upper_value","upper_tax_rate","lower_rule","lower_value","lower_tax_rate","revenue_sharing","required_spending")) p[[nm]] <- row[[nm]][1]
    if(p$upper_rule=="cap") p$cap_start <- 2028
    p
  }
  evaluate <- function(p,coef,response) {
    m <- simulate_policy(p,payroll_coef=coef,behavior_multiplier=response,full=FALSE,baseline=baseline)$metrics
    s <- negotiation_scores(p,m,details=FALSE)
    c(balance=m$competitive_balance_change,player=m$player_comp_change,club=m$club_effect,pool_remaining=m$prearb_remaining,
      mlb=s$mlb,mlbpa=s$mlbpa,compromise=s$compromise,viability=s$viability,joint=s$joint_support,
      cost_share=m$club_effect/sum(baseline$Revenue_Millions),worst_club_share=m$worst_club_effect_share,
      recipient_efficiency=m$recipient_efficiency,marginal_wins=m$recipient_marginal_wins)
  }
  policies_all <- Filter(function(p) !length(recommendation_checks(p)),lapply(seq_len(nrow(ids)),grid_policy))
  if(!length(policies_all)) stop("No realistic packages satisfy the selected terms. Try unlocking player terms or using proposal-inspired settings.")
  # Include the exact user-selected settings; never lose a manually discovered package.
  # Include reference presets as candidates if they meet the same guards.
  preset_candidates <- lapply(list(current_cba_policy(),mlb_proposal_policy(),mlbpa_proposal_policy()),function(p) modifyList(complete_policy(p),terms[bargaining_assumptions]))
  if(!lock_player_terms) policies_all <- c(policies_all,Filter(function(p) !length(recommendation_checks(p)),preset_candidates))
  policies_all <- c(list(terms),policies_all)
  make_policy <- function(i) policies_all[[i]]
  screened <- as.data.frame(t(vapply(seq_along(policies_all),function(i) {
    if(i%%100==0||i==length(policies_all)) progress(i,length(policies_all),"screen")
    evaluate(make_policy(i),terms$payroll_coef,behavior)
  },numeric(13))))
  # Refine promising packages with actual negotiated slider values, not changed model assumptions.
  # The selected behavior, player population, media share of revenue and model coefficients stay fixed.
  key <- function(p) paste(unlist(p),collapse="|")
  seen <- new.env(hash=TRUE,parent=emptyenv())
  for(i in seq_along(policies_all)) assign(key(policies_all[[i]]),TRUE,envir=seen)
  domains <- list(upper_value=c(180,200,220,240,250,258.2,260,280,300,320,350,400),
    upper_tax_rate=seq(0,100,10),lower_value=c(50,75,100,120,140,150,160,175,180.2,190,200,220),
    lower_tax_rate=seq(0,100,10),revenue_sharing=seq(0,50,5),required_spending=seq(0,100,10))
  if(!lock_player_terms) domains <- c(domains,list(minimum_salary_under2=c(.78,1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2),
    minimum_salary_2plus=c(.78,1,1.25,1.5,1.75,2),prearb_pool=seq(50,200,25),
    media_start=c(2027,2028),
    arbitration=c("2","3"),super_two_pct=c(22,44,66,100),min_arb_salary=c(0,1.5,3,5),
    arbitration_bonus_pct=c(0,2.5,5),veteran_bonus=c(0,.25,.5),prearb_min_bonus=c(0,.05,.1),free_agency=c("6","5_age30"),qualifying_offer=c(FALSE,TRUE)))
  financial_guard <- function(d) d$pool_remaining>=0 & d$cost_share>=-.05 & d$worst_club_share>=-.15
  # Economic outcomes dominate; mutual support rewards the weaker side continuously.
  # Allocation is an imperfect team-level proxy, not a measured labor-market welfare effect.
  score_packages <- function(d) {
    d$core_economic <- with(d,pmin(rescale01(balance),rescale01(player),rescale01(club)))
    d$allocation <- with(d,(rescale01(recipient_efficiency)+rescale01(marginal_wins))/2)
    d$economic <- .875*d$core_economic+.125*d$allocation
    d$overall <- d$compromise/100
    d
  }
  seed_ids <- function(d) {
    valid <- financial_guard(d) & vapply(policies_all,function(p) !length(recommendation_checks(p)),logical(1))
    ids <- which(valid)
    if(!length(ids)) return(integer())
    z <- score_packages(d[ids,,drop=FALSE])
    good <- which(z$balance>=0 & z$player>=0)
    unique(c(head(ids[good[order(z$compromise[good],decreasing=TRUE)]],12),
      head(ids[order(z$compromise,decreasing=TRUE)],6),
      head(ids[order(z$economic,decreasing=TRUE)],4)))
  }
  seeds <- unique(c(1L,seed_ids(screened)))
  for(pass in seq_len(3)) {
    new_ids <- integer()
    for(seed in seeds) {
      p <- policies_all[[seed]]
      for(nm in names(domains)) {
        vals <- domains[[nm]]
        if(nm=="upper_value") { if(p$upper_rule=="none") next; if(p$upper_rule=="cbt") vals<-vals[vals<=350 & vals==round(vals)] }
        if(nm=="upper_tax_rate"&&p$upper_rule!="cbt") next
        if(nm=="lower_value") { if(p$lower_rule=="none") next; if(p$lower_rule=="tax") vals<-vals[vals==round(vals)] }
        if(nm=="lower_tax_rate"&&p$lower_rule!="tax") next
        if(nm=="media_share_pct"&&!p$central_media) next
        for(v in vals) {
          q <- p; q[[nm]] <- v
          if(length(recommendation_checks(q))) next
          k <- key(q); if(exists(k,envir=seen,inherits=FALSE)) next
          assign(k,TRUE,envir=seen)
          policies_all[[length(policies_all)+1L]] <- q
          new_ids <- c(new_ids,length(policies_all))
        }
      }
    }
    if(!length(new_ids)) break
    extra <- as.data.frame(t(vapply(new_ids,function(i) evaluate(make_policy(i),terms$payroll_coef,behavior),numeric(13))))
    screened <- bind_rows(screened,extra)
    seeds <- seed_ids(screened)
    progress(nrow(screened),nrow(screened),"screen")
  }
  starting_support <- min(screened$mlb[1],screened$mlbpa[1])
  screened$id <- seq_len(nrow(screened))
  screened$realistic <- vapply(policies_all,function(p) !length(recommendation_checks(p)),logical(1))
  eligible <- screened[screened$realistic & financial_guard(screened),,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(eligible)) stop("No evaluated package meets the proposal-inspired ranges and modeled club-cost limits. No recommendation is available.")
  take <- function(d,key) head(d$id[order(d[[key]],decreasing=TRUE)],shortlist_size)
  eligible <- score_packages(eligible)
  feasible_central <- subset(eligible,balance>=0&player>=0)
  shortlist <- unique(c(take(feasible_central,"compromise"),take(eligible,"economic"),take(feasible_central,"economic"),
    take(eligible,"compromise"),take(eligible,"balance"),take(eligible,"player"),take(eligible,"club")))
  assumptions <- expand.grid(coef=unique(c(max(.001,terms$payroll_coef-payroll_effect_se),
    terms$payroll_coef,terms$payroll_coef+payroll_effect_se)),
    response=unique(c(max(.25,behavior*.75),behavior,min(2,behavior*1.25))))
  central_idx <- which(abs(assumptions$coef-terms$payroll_coef)<1e-10 & abs(assumptions$response-behavior)<1e-10)[1]
  # Audit candidates in descending central compromise order until one passes all guards.
  cache <- new.env(hash=TRUE,parent=emptyenv())
  sensitivity <- function(i) {
    k <- as.character(i)
    if(exists(k,envir=cache,inherits=FALSE)) return(get(k,envir=cache))
    p <- make_policy(i)
    d <- as.data.frame(t(vapply(seq_len(nrow(assumptions)),function(j)
      evaluate(p,assumptions$coef[j],assumptions$response[j]),numeric(13))))
    d$id <- i; d$assumption <- seq_len(nrow(assumptions))
    assign(k,d,envir=cache); d
  }
  robust_ok <- function(d) all(financial_guard(d)) && median(d$balance)>=0 && median(d$player)>=0 &&
    d$balance[central_idx]>=0 && d$player[central_idx]>=0
  ordered <- feasible_central$id[order(feasible_central$compromise,decreasing=TRUE)]
  checked <- integer(); verified_max <- NA_real_
  for(i in ordered) {
    checked <- c(checked,i)
    z <- sensitivity(i)
    if(robust_ok(z)) { verified_max <- z$compromise[central_idx]; break }
  }
  shortlist <- unique(c(checked,shortlist))
  all <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(shortlist),function(j) {
    progress(j,length(shortlist),"robust"); sensitivity(shortlist[j])
  }))
  viable_ids <- all %>% group_by(id) %>% summarise(valid=all(pool_remaining>=0 & cost_share>=-.05 & worst_club_share>=-.15),.groups="drop") %>% filter(valid) %>% pull(id)
  if(!length(viable_ids)) stop("No shortlisted package meets the modeled club-cost limits across sensitivity cases.")
  all <- all %>% filter(id %in% viable_ids) %>% group_by(assumption) %>% group_modify(~score_packages(.x)) %>% ungroup()
  summaries <- all %>% group_by(id) %>% summarise(
    median_overall=median(overall),median_economic=median(economic),median_core_economic=median(core_economic),median_allocation=median(allocation),
    median_balance=median(balance),pool_feasible=all(pool_remaining>=0),
    finance_feasible=all(cost_share>=-.05 & worst_club_share>=-.15),
    median_player_comp=median(player),median_club_effect=median(club),
    median_mlb_support=median(mlb),median_mlbpa_support=median(mlbpa),
    median_compromise=median(compromise),median_viability=median(viability),
    median_joint_support=median(joint),
    balance_positive_share=mean(balance>=0),player_positive_share=mean(player>=0),
    central_mlb=mlb[assumption==central_idx][1],central_mlbpa=mlbpa[assumption==central_idx][1],
    central_compromise=compromise[assumption==central_idx][1],central_balance=balance[assumption==central_idx][1],central_player=player[assumption==central_idx][1],.groups="drop")
  summaries$qualified <- with(summaries,pool_feasible&finance_feasible&
    central_balance>=0&central_player>=0&median_balance>=0&median_player_comp>=0)
  summaries <- summaries[summaries$pool_feasible & summaries$finance_feasible,,drop=FALSE]
  if(!nrow(summaries)) stop("No shortlisted package meets the modeled club-cost limits across sensitivity cases.")
  feasible <- summaries[summaries$qualified,]
  qualified <- nrow(feasible)>0
  ranked <- if(qualified) feasible else summaries
  best <- ranked %>% arrange(desc(central_compromise),desc(median_compromise),desc(median_economic),desc(median_joint_support)) %>% slice(1)
  choices <- bind_rows(
    best %>% mutate(Objective=if(qualified)"Best overall compromise" else "Best overall tradeoff (economic guardrail not met)"),
    summaries %>% arrange(desc(central_compromise),desc(median_compromise)) %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(Objective="Highest support (financial screen)"),
    summaries %>% arrange(desc(median_economic)) %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(Objective="Best economic result"),
    summaries %>% arrange(desc(median_balance)) %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(Objective="Competitive balance"),
    summaries %>% arrange(desc(median_player_comp)) %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(Objective="Player compensation"))
  policies <- lapply(choices$id,make_policy)
  recommended <- policies[[1]]
  sim <- simulate_policy(recommended,payroll_coef=terms$payroll_coef,behavior_multiplier=behavior,baseline=baseline)
  scores <- negotiation_scores(recommended,sim$metrics)
  stopifnot(best$central_compromise>=max(ranked$central_compromise)-1e-10)
  if(qualified) stopifnot(is.finite(verified_max),abs(best$central_compromise-verified_max)<1e-8)
  list(best=best,policy=recommended,simulation=sim,scores=scores,qualified=qualified,
    screened=nrow(screened),tested=length(shortlist),assumptions=nrow(assumptions),ranked_packages=ranked,
    starting_support=starting_support,best_central_support=max(pmin(eligible$mlb,eligible$mlbpa)),
    realistic_screened=nrow(eligible),verified_max=verified_max,checked_for_max=length(checked),
    alternatives=choices,alternative_policies=policies,locked=lock_player_terms,
    behavior=behavior,terms=terms)
}

# Reproduce Models 1 and 2 from the original research datasets and chronological holdouts.
research_validation <- function(payroll,revenue) {
  p <- payroll %>% filter(!Shortened_Season_2020,!is.na(Prior_Win_Pct),is.finite(Log_Payroll_Index))
  r <- revenue %>% filter(!Year %in% c(2020,2021),is.finite(Adjusted_Revenue),is.finite(Prior_Revenue_Millions))
  fits <- list("Model 1: Payroll and winning"=lm(Win_Pct~Log_Payroll_Index+Prior_Win_Pct+factor(Team_ID)+factor(Year),data=p),
    "Model 2: Winning and revenue"=lm(Adjusted_Revenue~Win_Pct+Prior_Revenue_Millions+factor(Team_ID)+factor(Year),data=r))
  details <- bind_rows(lapply(names(fits),function(nm) {
    s <- summary(fits[[nm]]); c <- coef(s)
    keep <- !grepl("^factor",rownames(c))
    data.frame(Model=nm,Term=rownames(c)[keep],Estimate=c[keep,1],SE=c[keep,2],
      T=c[keep,3],P=c[keep,4],R_squared=s$r.squared,Adjusted_R_squared=s$adj.r.squared,Observations=nobs(fits[[nm]]),row.names=NULL)
  }))
  rmse <- function(a,b) sqrt(mean((a-b)^2))
  pt <- p %>% filter(Year>=2019); pr <- p %>% filter(Year<=2018)
  pfit <- lm(Win_Pct~Log_Payroll_Index+Prior_Win_Pct+factor(Team_ID),data=pr)
  rt <- r %>% filter(Year>=2023); rr <- r %>% filter(Year<=2022)
  rfit <- lm(Adjusted_Revenue~Win_Pct+Prior_Revenue_Millions+factor(Team_ID),data=rr)
  rp <- lm(Adjusted_Revenue~Prior_Revenue_Millions,data=rr)
  errors <- data.frame(Model=c(rep("Model 1",3),rep("Model 2",3)),
    Method=c("Always .500","Prior-year wins","Payroll regression","League-average revenue","Prior revenue regression","Winning and revenue regression"),
    Holdout=c(rep("2019–2025 (2020 excluded)",3),rep("2023–2025",3)),
    RMSE=c(rmse(pt$Win_Pct,.5),rmse(pt$Win_Pct,pt$Prior_Win_Pct),rmse(pt$Win_Pct,predict(pfit,pt)),
      rmse(rt$Adjusted_Revenue,0),rmse(rt$Adjusted_Revenue,predict(rp,rt)),rmse(rt$Adjusted_Revenue,predict(rfit,rt))))
  list(coefficients=details,validation=errors)
}

name: transaction_impact.R
content:
# Transaction analysis uses the existing Models 1–5, never writes to a payroll snapshot.
# Amounts in millions. Salary proxy and CBT adjustment are separate inputs.
tx_rebase <- function(reference, cash, cbt, coef=payroll_effect, attendance_coef=.7638659) {
  n <- nrow(reference)
  stopifnot(n==30, length(cash)==n, length(cbt)==n, all(is.finite(c(cash,cbt))),
    all(cash+reference$Payroll_M>0), all(cbt+reference$CBT_Payroll_M>0),
    is.finite(coef),is.finite(attendance_coef))
  out <- reference
  out$Payroll_M <- reference$Payroll_M+cash
  out$CBT_Payroll_M <- reference$CBT_Payroll_M+cbt
  # Relative payroll changes, centered so each win still corresponds to a loss.
  raw <- coef*log((out$Payroll_M/mean(out$Payroll_M))/(reference$Payroll_M/mean(reference$Payroll_M)))
  dw <- raw-mean(raw)
  out$Win_Pct <- reference$Win_Pct+dw
  stopifnot(all(out$Win_Pct>=0 & out$Win_Pct<=1),abs(sum(out$Win_Pct)-sum(reference$Win_Pct))<1e-8)
  out$Attendance <- reference$Attendance*exp(attendance_coef*dw)
  # Model 5A's revenue estimate and baseline growth are already in the saved forecast.
  # Only the incremental Model 5B/C attendance and winning terms are applied.
  out$Revenue_Millions <- reference$Revenue_Millions*exp((.156374*attendance_coef+.141378)*dw)
  out$Model3_Wins_From_25M <- 162*coef*log1p(25/out$Payroll_M)
  out
}

tx_pair <- function(reference, teams, cash, cbt, direction="add",coef=payroll_effect,attendance_coef=.7638659) {
  stopifnot(length(teams)==length(cash),length(teams)==length(cbt),length(teams)>0,
    !anyDuplicated(teams),all(teams %in% reference$Team_ID),all(is.finite(c(cash,cbt))),
    direction %in% c("add","reverse"))
  a <- b <- rep(0,nrow(reference)); i <- match(teams,reference$Team_ID)
  a[i] <- cash; b[i] <- cbt
  # Reverse is a hypothetical without-transaction snapshot; it is not evidence of inclusion.
  if(direction=="reverse") list(before=tx_rebase(reference,-a,-b,coef,attendance_coef),after=reference)
  else list(before=reference,after=tx_rebase(reference,a,b,coef,attendance_coef))
}

tx_team_effects <- function(pair,coef=payroll_effect) {
  b <- pair$before; a <- pair$after
  stopifnot(identical(b$Team_ID,a$Team_ID))
  dp <- a$Payroll_M-b$Payroll_M
  dw <- 162*(a$Win_Pct-b$Win_Pct)
  gross <- 162*coef*log(a$Payroll_M/b$Payroll_M)
  data.frame(Team_ID=b$Team_ID,Club=b$Team_Name,Payroll_Before=b$Payroll_M,Payroll_After=a$Payroll_M,
    Payroll_Change=dp,CBT_Before=b$CBT_Payroll_M,CBT_After=a$CBT_Payroll_M,CBT_Change=a$CBT_Payroll_M-b$CBT_Payroll_M,
    Wins_Before=162*b$Win_Pct,Wins_After=162*a$Win_Pct,Wins_Change=dw,Gross_Wins=gross,
    Revenue_Change=a$Revenue_Millions-b$Revenue_Millions,
    Model2_Revenue_Change=b$Revenue_Millions*expm1(revenue_effect*dw/162),
    Attendance_Change=a$Attendance-b$Attendance,
    Efficiency_Before=(b$Win_Pct/.5)/(b$Payroll_M/mean(b$Payroll_M)),
    Efficiency_After=(a$Win_Pct/.5)/(a$Payroll_M/mean(a$Payroll_M)),
    Cost_Per_Gross_Win=ifelse(dp>0 & gross>1e-10,dp/gross,NA_real_),
    Net_Revenue_Less_Payroll=a$Revenue_Millions-b$Revenue_Millions-dp)
}

tx_league_effects <- function(pair) {
  b <- pair$before; a <- pair$after
  s0 <- sd(162*b$Win_Pct); s1 <- sd(162*a$Win_Pct)
  c(Payroll=sum(a$Payroll_M-b$Payroll_M),CBT=sum(a$CBT_Payroll_M-b$CBT_Payroll_M),
    Gini_Before=gini(b$Payroll_M),Gini_After=gini(a$Payroll_M),Balance=if(s0>0)100*(s0-s1)/s0 else NA_real_,
    Revenue=sum(a$Revenue_Millions-b$Revenue_Millions),Attendance=sum(a$Attendance-b$Attendance))
}

tx_active_rules <- function(p) {
  p <- complete_policy(p)
  if(p$upper_rule=="cap" && p$scenario_year<p$cap_start) {
    p$upper_rule <- "cbt";p$upper_value <- 244;p$upper_tax_rate <- 20
    if(p$lower_rule=="floor")p$lower_rule <- "none"
  }
  p
}

tx_position <- function(p,cbt) {
  p <- tx_active_rules(p)
  room <- if(p$upper_rule=="none")rep(NA_real_,length(cbt))else p$upper_value-cbt
  gap <- if(p$lower_rule=="none")rep(NA_real_,length(cbt))else pmax(p$lower_value-cbt,0)
  tax <- if(p$upper_rule=="cbt")pmax(cbt-p$upper_value,0)*p$upper_tax_rate/100 else rep(0,length(cbt))
  low_tax <- if(p$lower_rule=="tax")gap*p$lower_tax_rate/100 else rep(0,length(cbt))
  list(room=room,gap=gap,tax=tax,low_tax=low_tax,upper=p$upper_rule,lower=p$lower_rule)
}

tx_policy_effects <- function(pair,policies,coef=payroll_effect,response=1) {
  b <- pair$before;a <- pair$after
  rows <- lapply(names(policies),function(nm){
    p <- complete_policy(policies[[nm]])
    m0 <- simulate_policy(p,payroll_coef=coef,behavior_multiplier=response,baseline=b)
    m1 <- simulate_policy(p,payroll_coef=coef,behavior_multiplier=response,baseline=a)
    q0 <- tx_position(p,b$CBT_Payroll_M);q1 <- tx_position(p,a$CBT_Payroll_M)
    t0 <- m0$team;t1 <- m1$team
    # Direct club effects are relative to each simulation's own baseline; add the
    # change between those baselines to compare absolute annual revenue less payroll.
    net <- (a$Revenue_Millions-b$Revenue_Millions)-(a$Payroll_M-b$Payroll_M)+
      t1$Direct_Club_Effect_M-t0$Direct_Club_Effect_M
    list(team=data.frame(Agreement=nm,Team_ID=b$Team_ID,Club=b$Team_Name,
      Upper_Rule=q1$upper,Lower_Rule=q1$lower,Room_Before=q0$room,Room_After=q1$room,
      Floor_Gap_Before=q0$gap,Floor_Gap_After=q1$gap,
      Static_CBT_Change=q1$tax-q0$tax,Static_Low_Tax_Change=q1$low_tax-q0$low_tax,
      Modeled_Payroll_Change=t1$New_Payroll_M-t0$New_Payroll_M,
      Modeled_Wins_Change=t1$Predicted_Wins-t0$Predicted_Wins,
      Modeled_Revenue_Change=a$Revenue_Millions-b$Revenue_Millions+t1$Revenue_Change_M-t0$Revenue_Change_M,
      Modeled_Attendance_Change=a$Attendance-b$Attendance+t1$Predicted_Attendance_Change-t0$Predicted_Attendance_Change,
      Modeled_CBT_Change=t1$CBT_Exposure_M-t0$CBT_Exposure_M,
      Modeled_Low_Tax_Change=t1$Low_Spending_Tax_M-t0$Low_Spending_Tax_M,
      Club_Effect_Change=net),
      league=data.frame(Agreement=nm,Player_Comp_Change=m1$metrics$player_comp-m0$metrics$player_comp,
        Gini_Change=m1$metrics$gini-m0$metrics$gini,
        Balance_Change=if(m0$metrics$win_spread>0)100*(m0$metrics$win_spread-m1$metrics$win_spread)/m0$metrics$win_spread else NA_real_,
        Revenue_Change=sum(a$Revenue_Millions-b$Revenue_Millions)+m1$metrics$revenue_change-m0$metrics$revenue_change,
        Club_Effect_Change=sum(net)))
  })
  list(team=do.call(rbind,lapply(rows,"[[","team")),league=do.call(rbind,lapply(rows,"[[","league")))
}

tx_snapshot <- function(reference,payroll) {
  stopifnot(nrow(payroll)==30,!anyDuplicated(payroll$Team_ID),setequal(payroll$Team_ID,reference$Team_ID))
  i <- match(reference$Team_ID,payroll$Team_ID)
  tx_rebase(reference,payroll$Projected_2027_Payroll_Millions[i]-reference$Payroll_M,
    payroll$Projected_2027_CBT_Payroll_Millions[i]-reference$CBT_Payroll_M)
}

tx_history <- function(reference,path="data/payroll_history") {
  files <- sort(list.files(path,pattern="[.]csv$",full.names=TRUE))
  stopifnot(length(files)>0)
  snapshots <- lapply(files,function(f) {
    p <- read.csv(f,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    stopifnot(length(unique(p$Snapshot_Date))==1)
    list(date=as.character(p$Snapshot_Date[1]),file=basename(f),baseline=tx_snapshot(reference,p))
  })
  snapshots <- snapshots[order(vapply(snapshots,"[[",character(1),"date"),vapply(snapshots,"[[",character(1),"file"))]
  snapshots
}

tx_present_value <- function(payments,years,rate) {
  stopifnot(length(payments)==length(years),length(years)>0,all(is.finite(c(payments,years,rate))),
    all(payments>=0),all(years>=0),length(rate)==1,rate> -1)
  sum(payments/(1+rate)^years)
}

tx_contract_catalog <- function(ledger,signings,trades) {
  # The amount column is a suggested experiment, not a verified change to a snapshot.
  d <- ledger[ledger$Obligation_Season==2027, ,drop=FALSE]
  records <- list(hypothetical=list(label="Hypothetical transaction",teams="BAL",cash=25,cbt=25,
    note="Example: add $25M of annual salary and $25M of CBT payroll. Edit either amount.",direction="add"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {
    x <- d[i,];key <- paste("contract",x$Contract_ID,x$Club,x$Obligation_Season,sep=":")
    s <- signings[match(x$Contract_ID,signings$Signing_ID),,drop=FALSE]
    amount <- NA_real_; cb <- NA_real_;direction <- "add"
    note <- "Annual salary or a usable comparison amount has not been reported. Enter your own estimate to test a scenario."
    if(is.finite(x$Incremental_Payroll_M) && is.finite(x$Incremental_CBT_M) && x$Snapshot_Reconciliation!="Unreconciled") {
      amount <- x$Incremental_Payroll_M; cb <- x$Incremental_CBT_M
      note <- "Known difference from the saved contract amount. A zero difference means the obligation is already reflected in that comparison."
    } else if(is.finite(x$Difference_From_Projection_M)) {
      amount <- x$Difference_From_Projection_M;cb <- amount
      note <- "Salary settlement minus published arbitration projection. This assumes the projection was in the reference payroll and the CBT change equals the salary change; neither is confirmed."
    } else if(is.finite(x$Salary_Change_From_Prior_M)) {
      amount <- x$Salary_Change_From_Prior_M;cb <- amount
      note <- "Year-over-year salary difference used as a what-if adjustment. Prior salary is not necessarily in the projected payroll; equal CBT change is assumed."
    } else if(is.finite(x$Salary_M) && !x$Transaction_Type %in% c("Trade","Non-tender","Club option","Mutual option declined")) {
      amount <- x$Salary_M;cb <- if(is.finite(x$CBT_Charge_M))x$CBT_Charge_M else amount
      note <- "Reported annual salary compared with a hypothetical zero-salary alternative. No replacement salary is assumed. The CBT amount is assumed equal to annual salary unless verified."
    } else if(x$Transaction_Type=="Free agency" && nrow(s)==1 && is.finite(s$Nominal_AAV_Millions)) {
      amount <- s$Nominal_AAV_Millions;cb <- amount
      note <- "Reported average annual value used only as an illustrative flat annual salary and CBT change; the actual annual schedule and CBT charge are unknown."
    }
    records[[key]] <- list(label=paste(x$Player,x$Club,"—",x$Transaction_Type),teams=x$Club,cash=amount,cbt=cb,
      note=paste(note,"This experiment never changes the saved payroll."),direction=direction)
  }
  # Include new signings before their annual contract schedule is available.
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(signings))) {
    s <- signings[i,]
    if(is.na(s$New_Team_ID)||!s$New_Team_ID %in% base$Team_ID) next
    if(any(d$Contract_ID==s$Signing_ID & d$Club==s$New_Team_ID)) next
    known <- is.finite(s$Payroll_2027_Impact_Millions) && is.finite(s$CBT_2027_Impact_Millions)
    amount <- if(known)s$Payroll_2027_Impact_Millions else s$Nominal_AAV_Millions
    records[[paste0("signing:",s$Signing_ID)]] <- list(label=paste(s$Player,s$New_Team_ID,"— Free agency"),
      teams=s$New_Team_ID,cash=amount,cbt=if(known)s$CBT_2027_Impact_Millions else amount,direction="add",
      note=if(known)"Saved annual impact inputs; this is a what-if, not an additional payroll update." else "Average annual value used only as a hypothetical annual salary and CBT change. Verify the annual contract schedule.")
  }
  # Full trade: only auto-fill if every movement's annual salary transfer is known.
  for(id in unique(trades$Trade_ID[trades$Payroll_Season=="2027"])) {
    x <- trades[trades$Trade_ID==id & trades$Payroll_Season=="2027",,drop=FALSE]
    clubs <- sort(unique(c(x$From_Team_ID,x$To_Team_ID)))
    if(length(clubs)!=2)next
    dc <- dt <- rep(NA_real_,2)
    note <- "Complete trade selected. Some annual salary or retained salary figures are unknown. Enter each team's estimated net salary and CBT change. No full-deal total is assumed."
    if(all(is.finite(x$From_Club_Salary_Change_Millions)) && all(is.finite(x$To_Club_Salary_Change_Millions))) {
      dc <- vapply(clubs,function(k)sum(x$From_Club_Salary_Change_Millions[x$From_Team_ID==k])+sum(x$To_Club_Salary_Change_Millions[x$To_Team_ID==k]),numeric(1))
      if(all(is.finite(x$From_Club_CBT_Change_Millions))&&all(is.finite(x$To_Club_CBT_Change_Millions))) {
        dt <- vapply(clubs,function(k)sum(x$From_Club_CBT_Change_Millions[x$From_Team_ID==k])+sum(x$To_Club_CBT_Change_Millions[x$To_Team_ID==k]),numeric(1))
      }
      note <- "Reported full-deal salary changes; CBT remains unknown if not reported. This is a before-and-after scenario, not an automatic payroll update."
    }
    records[[paste0("trade:",id)]] <- list(label=paste(x$Transaction_Date[1],paste(clubs,collapse=" ↔ "),paste(x$Player,collapse=", "),sep=" — "),
      teams=clubs,cash=dc,cbt=dt,note=note,direction="add")
    # Offer individual known salary as a transparent partial-trade experiment.
    for(j in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
      q <- x[j,]; linked <- d[d$Player==q$Player & d$Club==q$To_Team_ID & d$Transaction_Type=="Trade",,drop=FALSE]
      if(nrow(linked)!=1 || !is.finite(linked$Salary_M)) next
      sal <- linked$Salary_M
      records[[paste0("movement:",q$Movement_ID)]] <- list(label=paste(q$Player,"— single-player trade scenario"),
        teams=c(q$From_Team_ID,q$To_Team_ID),cash=c(-sal,sal),cbt=c(-sal,sal),direction="add",
        note="Partial trade only: reported annual salary with no retained salary and equal CBT transfer assumed. Other players and cash in the deal are excluded; edit amounts to test retention.")
    }
  }
  records
}

# Isolate the effect of a single recorded signing by removing its applied
# adjustments from the latest live scenario. Never add the same deal again.
# Missing amounts remain unknown; calculated wins are conditional on known
# adjustments only, not a full-player valuation or a schedule forecast.
tx_recorded_signing_effect <- function(reference, signing, events, coef=payroll_effect, attendance_coef=.7638659) {
  stopifnot(nrow(signing)==1L)
  ids <- unique(na.omit(c(as.character(signing$New_Team_ID),as.character(signing$Previous_Team_ID))))
  ids <- ids[nzchar(ids)]
  stopifnot(length(ids)>0,all(ids %in% reference$Team_ID))
  e <- events[events$Effective_Season==2027 & events$Event_ID==signing$Signing_ID,,drop=FALSE]
  # A non-tender may precede a new signing. Show that earlier departure as
  # already reflected, never apply its reduction a second time.
  idx <- match(ids,e$Club)
  cash <- ifelse(!is.na(idx) & e$Payroll_Status[idx]!="Pending",e$New_Payroll_M[idx]-e$Prior_Payroll_M[idx],NA_real_)
  cbt <- ifelse(!is.na(idx) & e$CBT_Status[idx]=="Confirmed",e$New_CBT_M[idx]-e$Prior_CBT_M[idx],NA_real_)
  statuses <- ifelse(is.na(idx),"Not recorded",e$Payroll_Status[idx])
  proxy <- !is.na(idx) & grepl("nominal AAV spending proxy ONLY",e$Notes[idx],fixed=TRUE)
  statuses[proxy] <- "Provisional AAV proxy"
  if(signing$Status=="Withdrawn") {cash[] <- NA_real_;cbt[] <- NA_real_;statuses[] <- "Withdrawn"}
  other_exit <- events[events$Effective_Season==2027 & events$Player==signing$Player &
    grepl("^2026-nt-",events$Event_ID) & events$Payroll_Status!="Pending",,drop=FALSE]
  prior_exit <- ids!=signing$New_Team_ID & ids %in% other_exit$Club & is.na(cash)
  statuses[prior_exit] <- "Prior non-tender; not counted again"
  known <- is.finite(cash) | is.finite(cbt)
  result <- data.frame(Team_ID=ids,Role=ifelse(ids==signing$New_Team_ID,"Signing club","Previous club"),
    Payroll_Change=cash,CBT_Change=cbt,Payroll_Status=statuses,Conditional_Wins=NA_real_)
  league <- NULL
  if(any(is.finite(cash))) {
    dc <- ifelse(is.finite(cash),cash,0)
    dt <- ifelse(is.finite(cbt),cbt,0)
    pair <- tx_pair(reference,ids,dc,dt,"reverse",coef,attendance_coef)
    league <- tx_team_effects(pair,coef)
    result$Conditional_Wins <- league$Wins_Change[match(ids,league$Team_ID)]
  }
  list(clubs=result,league=league,partial=any(!is.finite(cash)),any_applied=any(known))
}

# Transaction impact UI and server helpers. All calculations use saved snapshots.
transaction_impact_ui <- function(teams) {
  div(class="tx-center",div(class="page-head",div(class="eyebrow","MLB FINANCIAL DATA"),h2("Transaction Economics"),
    p("Explore how a signing, trade or arbitration agreement changes team finances and the next CBA.")),
  div(class="tx-workspace",div(class="dashboard-panel tx-controls",h3("Analyze a transaction"),
    radioButtons("tx_filter","Transaction type",c("All","Free agency","Trades","Arbitration","Other"),inline=TRUE),
    selectInput("tx_record","Select a reported transaction or build your own",choices=c("Hypothetical transaction"="hypothetical")),
    textOutput("tx_evidence"),
    uiOutput("tx_missing_note"),
    conditionalPanel("input.tx_two && !output.tx_ready", actionButton("tx_trade_example","Run illustrative $5M transfer",class="btn-default"),p(class="small-note","Example only: add $5M to the first club, subtract $5M from the second, with equal CBT changes. Not a reported trade amount.")),
    radioButtons("tx_direction","Comparison",c("Add to saved payroll (what-if)"="add","Remove from saved payroll (what-if)"="reverse"),inline=TRUE),
    fluidRow(column(4,selectInput("tx_team1","Team",teams,selected="BAL")),
      column(4,numericInput("tx_cash1","Annual payroll change ($M)",25,step=.1)),
      column(4,numericInput("tx_cbt1","Luxury tax payroll change ($M)",25,step=.1))),
    checkboxInput("tx_two","Include another team (trade)",FALSE),
    conditionalPanel("input.tx_two",fluidRow(column(4,selectInput("tx_team2","Second team",teams,selected="NYY")),
      column(4,numericInput("tx_cash2","Annual payroll change ($M)",-25,step=.1)),
      column(4,numericInput("tx_cbt2","Luxury tax payroll change ($M)",-25,step=.1)))),
    selectInput("tx_year","CBA rules effective in",c("2027","2028")),
    checkboxInput("tx_confirm","Use my estimates for unknown contract terms",FALSE),
    p(class="small-note","All comparisons use the partial 2027 Live Payroll scenario (2026 carry-forward and reviewed adjustments). 2028 tests later CBA rules, not a separate payroll forecast. Enter net salary changes after retention and replacement costs; CBT is separate. No edits are saved.")),
  div(class="tx-results",uiOutput("tx_status"),conditionalPanel("output.tx_ready",uiOutput("tx_summary"),
  div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Team economic impact"),p("Model 1 predicts changes from payroll, not individual talent. Model 3 measures gross marginal wins; league-adjusted wins sum to zero. Model 5 predicts changes in attendance and revenue."),
    DTOutput("tx_team_effects"),plotlyOutput("tx_wins_plot",height="280px")),
  div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("How the deal changes under each CBA"),
    p("The threshold comparison holds payroll fixed. The modeled results include clubs' spending responses, salary rules and revenue sharing. Tax amounts use the simulator's simplified rates, not exact legal tax bills."),
    h4("Payroll thresholds before and after"),DTOutput("tx_rules"),h4("Team impact after modeled spending responses"),DTOutput("tx_policy_results"),h4("League-wide impact"),DTOutput("tx_league_results"))))),
  div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Team financial dashboard"),selectInput("tx_focus_team","Club",teams,selected="BAL"),
    uiOutput("tx_team_finances"),DTOutput("tx_team_contracts")),
  div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Contract value and present value"),
    p("Optional finance analysis: enter actual or hypothetical annual cash payments in millions. Deferred payments belong in the years they are paid; a signing bonus paid immediately goes in year 0. This does not calculate official CBT valuation."),
    textInput("tx_payments","Cash payments by year, starting at year 0","0,25,25,25,25,25"),
    sliderInput("tx_discount","Annual discount rate (%)",0,15,5,step=.5),uiOutput("tx_pv")))
}

transaction_offseason_ui <- function() {
  tagList(div(class="page-head",div(class="eyebrow","MLB FINANCIAL DATA"),h2("Offseason Economics"),

    uiOutput("offseason_metrics"),
    div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Payroll and payroll inequality over time"),plotlyOutput("offseason_plot",height="340px"),
      p(class="small-note","Each point is a saved snapshot, not a complete daily transaction history.")),
    div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Largest team payroll changes"),DTOutput("offseason_teams")),
    div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Arbitration settlements"),p("Actual salary versus prior salary and published projection. Missing terms are not zero."),DTOutput("offseason_arb")),
    div(class="dashboard-panel",h3("Best Compromise tracker"),p("Run the existing optimizer on the earliest and latest saved payroll snapshots with identical CBA settings. This compares two economic scenarios; it does not automatically save a recommendation or run costly searches on every page load."),
      actionButton("offseason_compare_best","Compare best compromises",class="btn-primary"),uiOutput("offseason_best")))

register_transaction_economics <- function(input,output,session,reference,current_policy,comparison_context,signings,trades) {
  catalog <- reactive(tx_contract_catalog(contract_ledger(),signings(),trades()))
  chosen <- reactive(catalog()[[input$tx_record %||% "hypothetical"]] %||% catalog()[["hypothetical"]])
  observe({
    c <- catalog()
    keys <- names(c);labels <- vapply(c,"[[",character(1),"label")
    f <- input$tx_filter %||% "All"
    keep <- switch(f,"Free agency"=grepl("Free agency|Qualifying offer",labels),"Trades"=grepl("^(trade|movement):",keys),
      "Arbitration"=grepl("Arbitration",labels),"Other"=!grepl("Free agency|Qualifying offer|Arbitration",labels)&!grepl("^(trade|movement):",keys),rep(TRUE,length(keys)))
    keep[keys=="hypothetical"] <- TRUE
    choices <- setNames(keys[keep],labels[keep]);current <- isolate(input$tx_record %||% "hypothetical")
    updateSelectInput(session,"tx_record",choices=choices,selected=if(current %in% choices)current else "hypothetical")
  })
  observeEvent(input$tx_record,{
    x <- chosen()
    updateSelectInput(session,"tx_team1",selected=x$teams[1])
    updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cash1",value=if(is.finite(x$cash[1]))x$cash[1]else 0)
    updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cbt1",value=if(is.finite(x$cbt[1]))x$cbt[1]else 0)
    updateCheckboxInput(session,"tx_two",value=length(x$teams)==2)
    if(length(x$teams)==2){
      updateSelectInput(session,"tx_team2",selected=x$teams[2])
      updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cash2",value=if(is.finite(x$cash[2]))x$cash[2]else 0)
      updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cbt2",value=if(is.finite(x$cbt[2]))x$cbt[2]else 0)
    }
    updateRadioButtons(session,"tx_direction",selected=x$direction)
    updateCheckboxInput(session,"tx_confirm",value=FALSE)
  })
  output$tx_evidence <- renderText(chosen()$note)
  output$tx_missing_note <- renderUI({
    x <- chosen()
    if(any(!is.finite(c(x$cash,x$cbt)))) div(class="plain-box","Unknown amounts appear as editable zero placeholders, not reported values. Enter and confirm estimates to calculate.")
  })
  observeEvent(input$tx_trade_example,{
    req(isTRUE(input$tx_two),input$tx_team1,input$tx_team2,input$tx_team1!=input$tx_team2)
    updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cash1",value=5)
    updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cbt1",value=5)
    updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cash2",value=-5)
    updateNumericInput(session,"tx_cbt2",value=-5)
    updateRadioButtons(session,"tx_direction",selected="add")
    updateCheckboxInput(session,"tx_confirm",value=TRUE)
  },ignoreInit=TRUE)
  readiness <- reactive({
    x <- chosen()
    if(!all(is.finite(c(x$cash,x$cbt))) && !isTRUE(input$tx_confirm))
      return(list(message="Full financial terms are not available. Enter your own net payroll and CBT estimates for each club, then confirm them, or choose the illustrative transfer example for a trade. No confirmed trade impact is claimed."))
    ids <- input$tx_team1;cash <- input$tx_cash1;cbt <- input$tx_cbt1
    if(isTRUE(input$tx_two)){ids <- c(ids,input$tx_team2);cash <- c(cash,input$tx_cash2);cbt <- c(cbt,input$tx_cbt2)}
    if(length(ids)==0||length(ids)!=length(cash)||length(ids)!=length(cbt)||anyDuplicated(ids)||!all(is.finite(c(cash,cbt)))||is.null(input$tx_direction))
      return(list(message="Enter finite payroll changes for distinct teams."))
    p <- current_policy()
    z <- tryCatch(tx_pair(reference(),ids,cash,cbt,input$tx_direction,p$payroll_coef,p$attendance_coef),error=function(e)NULL)
    if(is.null(z))return(list(message="Changes must leave positive payrolls and valid projected winning percentages."))
    list(pair=z,ids=ids,message=NULL)
  })
  output$tx_ready <- reactive(is.null(readiness()$message))
  outputOptions(output,"tx_ready",suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)
  output$tx_status <- renderUI({
    state <- readiness()
    if(!is.null(state$message)) div(class="dashboard-panel",h3(chosen()$label),p(state$message),p(class="small-note","The saved payroll baseline is unchanged."))
  })
  pair <- reactive({
    state <- readiness()
    req(is.null(state$message))
    list(pair=state$pair,ids=state$ids)
  })
  rows <- reactive(tx_team_effects(pair()$pair,current_policy()$payroll_coef))
  active <- reactive({r <- rows();r[r$Team_ID %in% pair()$ids,,drop=FALSE]})
  comparisons <- reactive({
    p <- current_policy(); context <- comparison_context(); context$scenario_year <- as.integer(input$tx_year %||% "2027")
    policies <- lapply(list("Current CBA"=current_cba_policy(),"MLB proposal"=mlb_proposal_policy(),"MLBPA proposal"=mlbpa_proposal_policy(),"Your CBA"=p),function(q)modifyList(complete_policy(q),context))
    tx_policy_effects(pair()$pair,policies,p$payroll_coef,input$behavior_response %||% 1)
  })
  stat <- function(label,value,help="")div(class="tx-stat",div(class="metric-label",label),strong(value),p(help))
  dollars <- function(x)paste0("$",format(round(x,2),nsmall=2,trim=TRUE),"M")
  tab <- function(x,cols=NULL) {
    q <- app_table(x,rownames=FALSE,options=list(dom="t",scrollX=TRUE,paging=FALSE,ordering=FALSE))
    if(length(cols))q <- DT::formatRound(q,cols,3)
    q
  }
  output$tx_summary <- renderUI({
    r <- active();v <- tx_league_effects(pair()$pair)
    div(class="dashboard-panel",h3(chosen()$label),p(if(isTRUE(input$tx_confirm))"Illustrative scenario using your estimates, not confirmed contract terms or an actual payroll update."else"What-if comparison using the saved 2027 projection; not a confirmed payroll update."),
      div(class="tx-stat-grid",stat("League payroll change",money_text(v[["Payroll"]],2)),
        stat("Payroll Gini change",sprintf("%+.4f",v[["Gini_After"]]-v[["Gini_Before"]])),
        stat("Competitive balance change",percent_text(v[["Balance"]],2)),
        stat("Projected league revenue change",money_text(v[["Revenue"]],2))),
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(r)),function(i)div(class="tx-team-line",strong(r$Club[i]),
        span(paste(dollars(r$Payroll_Before[i]),"→",dollars(r$Payroll_After[i]))),
        span(paste(sprintf("%+.2f",r$Wins_Change[i]),"predicted wins")),
        span(paste(money_text(r$Revenue_Change[i],2),"revenue")),
        span(paste(format(round(r$Attendance_Change[i]),big.mark=","),"attendance change")))))
  })
  output$tx_team_effects <- renderDT({
    r <- active()
    d <- data.frame(Team=r$Team_ID,`Payroll before ($M)`=r$Payroll_Before,`Payroll after ($M)`=r$Payroll_After,
      `Predicted wins change`=r$Wins_Change,`Gross marginal wins`=r$Gross_Wins,
      `Revenue change ($M)`=r$Revenue_Change,`Model 2 revenue ($M)`=r$Model2_Revenue_Change,
      `Attendance change`=round(r$Attendance_Change),`Efficiency before`=r$Efficiency_Before,`Efficiency after`=r$Efficiency_After,
      `Cost per gross win ($M)`=r$Cost_Per_Gross_Win,`Revenue less payroll ($M)`=r$Net_Revenue_Less_Payroll,check.names=FALSE)
    tab(d,names(d)[-1])
  })
  output$tx_wins_plot <- renderPlotly({
    r <- rows()
    plot_ly(r,x=~reorder(Team_ID,Wins_Change),y=~Wins_Change,type="bar",text=~Club,
      marker=list(color=ifelse(r$Team_ID %in% pair()$ids,"#3b82b4",ifelse(r$Wins_Change>=0,"#75ab9b","#ca817a")))) %>%
      layout(xaxis=list(title="Club"),yaxis=list(title="Predicted win change"),margin=list(b=55,t=10,l=60,r=15),showlegend=FALSE) %>% config(displaylogo=FALSE)
  })
  output$tx_rules <- renderDT({
    d <- comparisons()$team;d <- d[d$Team_ID %in% pair()$ids,]
    x <- data.frame(CBA=d$Agreement,Team=d$Team_ID,`Upper rule`=d$Upper_Rule,
      `Room before ($M)`=d$Room_Before,`Room after ($M)`=d$Room_After,`Lower gap before ($M)`=d$Floor_Gap_Before,
      `Lower gap after ($M)`=d$Floor_Gap_After,`CBT change ($M)`=d$Static_CBT_Change,`Low tax change ($M)`=d$Static_Low_Tax_Change,check.names=FALSE)
    tab(x,names(x)[-(1:3)])
  })
  output$tx_policy_results <- renderDT({
    d <- comparisons()$team;d <- d[d$Team_ID %in% pair()$ids,]
    x <- data.frame(CBA=d$Agreement,Team=d$Team_ID,`Modeled payroll change ($M)`=d$Modeled_Payroll_Change,
      `Wins change`=d$Modeled_Wins_Change,`Revenue change ($M)`=d$Modeled_Revenue_Change,
      `Attendance change`=round(d$Modeled_Attendance_Change),`CBT change ($M)`=d$Modeled_CBT_Change,
      `Low tax change ($M)`=d$Modeled_Low_Tax_Change,`Direct club effect ($M)`=d$Club_Effect_Change,check.names=FALSE)
    tab(x,names(x)[-(1:2)])
  })
  output$tx_league_results <- renderDT({
    d <- comparisons()$league;names(d) <- c("CBA","Player pay change ($M)","Gini change","Balance change (%)","Revenue change ($M)","Direct club effect ($M)")
    tab(d,names(d)[-1])
  })
  output$tx_team_finances <- renderUI({
    b <- reference();i <- match(input$tx_focus_team,b$Team_ID);req(length(i)==1,!is.na(i))
    div(class="tx-stat-grid",stat("Projected payroll",dollars(b$Payroll_M[i])),
      stat("Projected CBT payroll",dollars(b$CBT_Payroll_M[i])),
      stat("Projected wins",sprintf("%.2f",162*b$Win_Pct[i])),
      stat("Projected revenue",dollars(b$Revenue_Millions[i])))
  })
  output$tx_team_contracts <- renderDT({
    req(input$tx_focus_team);d <- contract_ledger();d <- d[d$Club==input$tx_focus_team,]
    tab(data.frame(Player=d$Player,Type=d$Transaction_Type,Season=d$Obligation_Season,Salary=d$Salary_M,Status=d$Status),"Salary")
  })
  output$tx_pv <- renderUI({
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(strsplit(input$tx_payments %||% "",",",fixed=TRUE)[[1]])))
    validate(need(length(x)>0&&all(is.finite(x)&x>=0),"Enter nonnegative cash payments separated by commas."))
    div(class="tx-stat-grid",stat("Nominal cash total",dollars(sum(x))),stat("Present value",dollars(tx_present_value(x,seq_along(x)-1,(input$tx_discount %||% 5)/100))))
  })
  history <- reactive(tx_history(reference()))
  history_pair <- reactive({h <- history();list(before=h[[1]]$baseline,after=h[[length(h)]]$baseline)})
  output$offseason_metrics <- renderUI({
    h <- history();v <- tx_league_effects(history_pair());s <- signings();known <- s$Total_Value_Millions[is.finite(s$Total_Value_Millions)]
    tagList(p(paste("Saved snapshots:",h[[1]]$date,"to",h[[length(h)]]$date,"·",length(h),"snapshots")),
      div(class="tx-stat-grid",stat("Reported contract value",dollars(sum(known)),paste(length(known),"reported values; multi-year total")),
        stat("Projected 2027 payroll change",money_text(v[["Payroll"]],2)),
        stat("Payroll Gini",sprintf("%.4f → %.4f",v[["Gini_Before"]],v[["Gini_After"]])),
        stat("Competitive balance change",percent_text(v[["Balance"]],2))))
  })
  output$offseason_plot <- renderPlotly({
    h <- history();x <- seq_along(h);dates <- vapply(h,"[[",character(1),"date")
    pay <- vapply(h,function(z)sum(z$baseline$Payroll_M),numeric(1));g <- vapply(h,function(z)gini(z$baseline$Payroll_M),numeric(1))
    p1 <- plot_ly(x=x,y=pay,type="scatter",mode="lines+markers",name="Payroll ($M)")%>%layout(yaxis=list(title="Payroll ($M)"))
    p2 <- plot_ly(x=x,y=g,type="scatter",mode="lines+markers",name="Gini coefficient")%>%layout(yaxis=list(title="Gini coefficient"))
    subplot(p1,p2,nrows=2,shareX=TRUE,titleY=TRUE)%>%layout(xaxis=list(tickvals=x,ticktext=dates,title="Saved snapshot"),showlegend=FALSE)%>%config(displaylogo=FALSE)
  })
  output$offseason_teams <- renderDT({
    d <- tx_team_effects(history_pair());d <- d[order(abs(d$Payroll_Change),decreasing=TRUE),]
    cols <- c("Club","Payroll_Before","Payroll_After","Payroll_Change","Wins_Change","Revenue_Change","Attendance_Change")
    tab(d[,cols],cols[-1])
  })
  output$offseason_arb <- renderDT({
    d <- contract_ledger();d <- d[d$Transaction_Type=="Arbitration settlement" & d$Obligation_Season==2027,]
    z <- data.frame(Player=d$Player,Team=d$Club,`Salary ($M)`=d$Salary_M,`Prior salary ($M)`=d$Prior_Salary_M,
      `Projection ($M)`=d$Published_Projection_M,`Raise ($M)`=d$Salary_Change_From_Prior_M,`Difference from projection ($M)`=d$Difference_From_Projection_M,check.names=FALSE)
    tab(z,names(z)[-(1:2)])
  })
  best_cache <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(input$offseason_compare_best,{
    h <- history();p <- current_policy();response <- input$behavior_response %||% 1
    result <- tryCatch(withProgress(message="Comparing saved payroll snapshots",value=0,{
      lapply(c(1,length(h)),function(i) {
        opt <- optimize_cba(p,h[[i]]$baseline,behavior=response)
        incProgress(.5);list(date=h[[i]]$date,opt=opt)
      })
    }),error=function(e)list(error=conditionMessage(e)))
    best_cache(result)
  })
  output$offseason_best <- renderUI({
    q <- best_cache();if(is.null(q))return(p("Run the comparison to see how the recommendation changes."))
    if(!is.null(q$error))return(p(q$error))
    tagList(p("Results use the settings at the time of this search. Run again after changing settings."),
      lapply(q,function(z)div(class="dashboard-panel",h4(z$date),p(policy_label(z$opt$policy)),
        p(paste("MLB",score_text(z$opt$scores$mlb),"· MLBPA",score_text(z$opt$scores$mlbpa))),
        p(paste("Competitive balance",percent_text(z$opt$simulation$metrics$competitive_balance_change,2),
          "· Player pay",money_text(z$opt$simulation$metrics$player_comp_change,2))),
        p(if(z$opt$qualified)"Meets the economic requirements."else"No qualifying package found."))))
  })
  function(key) {
    if(!key %in% names(catalog()))return()
    removeModal();updateRadioButtons(session,"nav_group",selected="MLB Financial Data")
    updateRadioButtons(session,"finance_tab",selected="Transaction Economics")
    updateRadioButtons(session,"tx_filter",selected="All")
    updateSelectInput(session,"tx_record",choices=setNames(names(catalog()),vapply(catalog(),"[[",character(1),"label")),selected=key)
  }
}
